name: gamemaker-kit
description: Game development workflow plugin for Claude Code. Falsify un-fun in HTML before touching the engine: 29 skills + 4 domain agents covering 4 axes (time / discipline / validation / integration). Playwright bots with 4 procedural personas + your own self-test gate, then a 6-stage HTML→Godot/Unity port re-validation. Domain agents wired into SKILL routing (v0.3). Project-level release-readiness checkpoint via /gmk-dev-complete (v0.3). v0.4-v0.7 completed four half-applied-standard sweeps with a maturing structural pre-flight guard. v0.8 closed the last declared-but-half-applied field with Rule 17 (pillars.kind enum read contract + Check G), promoted Check B to FAIL with whole-word regex, hardened both allowlists with verified-at-SHA stamps, and formalized the HANDOFF backlog template to mitigate F21 anchoring. v0.9 annotates Rule 16's three unreachable kit_version rows as safety valves (Protocol 1 narrowed M-2 from 4 false-positive dead branches to 3 genuine ones), closes the last live half-applied field _save_breaking by dropping its single mention (0 readers → 0 mentions), bumps stale ~28-skills count across 5 doc sites to 29, fills the Protocol 1 corrections ratio tracking table, captures a gmk-port split decision (KEEP at 684), and produces the v1.0 backward-compat inventory enumerating six categories of v0.x guarantees as deliberate-break candidates. Fourth consecutive ACCURATE release. dev-complete is a checkpoint (recomputable), not an endpoint — release and live-ops remain out of scope by design.
